title: Dataverse-backed procurement app
design: Five selected model/effort combinations, twice each, in two reverse-order blocks. Sequential builds against the same dedicated Dataverse tables, restored to the same seed between runs.

controls.businessUseCaseFraming: Normal device procurement and availability app connected to Device List and Device Requests. Benchmark tooling, cost measurement and internal isolation markers stay out of the application UI. Display-name-only Dataverse changes preserve the table IDs and seed.
controls.setupCosts: Provisioning and superseded diagnostic attempts are separate from the ten app-build costs.
controls.connectorValidation: The diagnostic was stopped before schema approval after the user requested normal business-use-case framing. Backend schema and seed are independently verified. The first measured business-app build also establishes end-to-end Cowork connector access; this is not a claimed successful warm-connection preflight. If a common authorization/platform blocker prevents connection, pause further measured builds rather than repeatedly charging for the same unresolved setup failure.
controls.promptRule: Bind the organization URL once into the business-use-case prompt, then hash and reuse its exact text for all ten runs. The same simple connection request is included in every fresh app; no run identifier or per-run hint is inserted.
controls.remediationRule: Identify only observed failed acceptance IDs and symptoms. No supplied implementation, new features, publication or unrelated resource changes.
controls.approvalRule: Record every approval. Only the two registered synthetic tables are authorized; stop for broader permissions or a sign-in boundary.
controls.stopRule: Stop at verified acceptance, two corrections, or a platform/authorization boundary. Preserve failed and incomplete results; capture final /cost when available.
controls.sharedDataRule: Archive backend records before resetting. Verify organization ID, table metadata IDs, solution membership, ownership description and BenchmarkTag. Refuse foreign records, unknown device records, ambiguous keys or concurrent writes. Close the preceding app before the next build; no app may seed/reset on startup.

analysis.acceptance: At least 85/100 and every critical check. Untested and blocked earn no points.
analysis.backendEvidence: Read Dataverse server records independently after request/approval/rejection/reset and after reloading/reopening the app. Frontend state and generated-code claims alone cannot establish persistence.
analysis.comparison: Compare paired runs within Test 2 first. Test 1 differs in backing-store availability, so it is not an isolated estimate of Dataverse's incremental price. The retired wrong-tenant SharePoint setup is not a measured model failure.
limitations: Two repetitions per condition are not a statistical guarantee
Selected Cowork model may differ from internal builder routing
The first measured build may establish a cold connection; subsequent connection reuse, caching and fixed order can affect consumption
Synthetic persona switching is not production authorization
Sequential stock tests do not prove cross-table atomicity or simultaneous-user safety
Task credits are not a tenant invoice
outOfScope: Unrelated Dataverse records or retired SharePoint content
